items.rationale: COUNT counts only numbers: 12, 0, 5 and 30 make 4. The text n/a and the empty cell are ignored, but 0 is a number so it is counted.
COUNT looks at the type of the cell, not its size. 0 is a number, so it is counted. This matters: a line with 0 pairs has been counted, while an empty cell has not.
SUM adds 25 + 40 + 0 + 15 = 80 and COUNT finds 4 numbers, so 80 / 4 = 20. The text TBC and the empty cell are in neither the total nor the count.
An apostrophe at the front tells Excel to store the entry as text, and COUNT counts only real numbers. It does not return an error: the cell is simply skipped.
